meta.title: Friday Night Paper Fight - 4 Player Commander
meta.game_window: Game runs ~9:35 to ~2:17:30; intro/housekeeping before, subs/outro after

result.winner_confidence: medium - final sequence partially garbled in ASR; supported by elimination order and postgame chat

eliminations.cause: Two conspired X-damage fire spells from Ben ('took two fireballs to the face, I got murdered')

meta.extraction_method: YouTube auto-generated captions (ASR, no speaker labels, 2019-era). Condensed key-event log; timestamps allow re-extraction of any segment.
meta.note: Complete game with winner. Exceptionally dense in rules-teaching moments - 15+ validated rulings including two on-camera CORRECT_CATCH moments (color identity violation, exile-vs-graveyard processor timing).

players.name: Ian

players.name: Ben
players.deck: RG goblin tokens + conspire X-spells (Devil's Play, Fireball, Burn from Within)

key_events.detail: Hands drawn pre-stream; roll-off: Adam rolled 9 on a d12, goes first. 'I draw my card because that's what you do in commander' - multiplayer first-turn draw

Conspire: 'technically you can't tap green creatures to conspire a red spell' - conspire requires tapping two untapped creatures that EACH SHARE A COLOR with the spell. For Wort's RG spells either color works; statement is correct for a mono-red spell

key_events.card: Sandstone Oracle? / early Eldrazi ramp; also names 'Eldrazi' with a naming effect (heard 'What are you naming - I named Eldrazi')

key_events.detail: Sylvan Library rules recited correctly: draw 3 in draw step, keep extras for 4 life each
Enchantment spells cost 1 less; gain 1 life on enchantment cast (confirmed at 21:02 'do I gain a life because this is an enchantment creature? yes' - bestowed/enchantment creature counts)

key_events.card: Artifact Mutation on Adam's Urza's Incubator
key_events.detail: Destroy artifact + create X 1/1 Saplings = its mana value
Table notes he could have BESTOWED it instead (bestow = alternative cost, sorcery-timing aura mode)
Side discussion: gold-bordered cards allowed in this casual pod; house-rule territory

THE defining card of the game: opponents can't CAST spells with even mana value; creatures with even MV can't BLOCK. Table immediately hits the classic rulings: reminder text 'Zero is even' (25:07-25:17), token creatures (MV 0) can't block (25:23-25:30, initially said 'attack', corrected to block)
3, tap, sac: return all enchantment cards from graveyard to hand

key_events.card: Not of This World (free - targets his own permanent being targeted?)
key_events.detail: 28:52: casts it for free 'we knew those in your hand'; counters spell targeting his permanent
Recruiter stacked goblins on top; Ringleader reveals top 4, puts goblins in hand - classic combo, notes at 41:18 he forgot Goblin Warchief was NOT in the deck for the full combo
Kozilek's owner puts him in the COMMAND ZONE instead of exile (replacement choice)

EXCELLENT multi-minute ruling with chat judges: does Kozilek 'come back' if Banishing Light is destroyed? Conclusion: while the commander sits in the command zone Banishing Light has 'lost track' of it; if the commander is CAST again it is a NEW object and Banishing Light's return-effect can never bring it back; casting from CZ does not trigger legend-rule issues with the exiled 'copy'
SECOND textbook moment: Ben plays Dryad Arbor under Void Winnower. 'Dryad Arbor isn't a spell - lands are not cast, lands are PLAYED' - so the even-MV restriction doesn't apply
Deals X damage to target creature, X = goblins on battlefield (4) - targets Void Winnower... (53:16 'I'm gonna put four damage on the Widower')
Commander tax doesn't change mana value: Kozilek's MV 'never stops being even' under Void Winnower no matter how many times tax is added - cost increases don't change MV
'Is odd/even checked before or after discount effects? Before - discounts don't change the MV' - cost reduction never alters mana value
Kozilek attacks Graham for 11-12 commander damage; commander damage tracked ('coming in for 11... 12 12')
Ben nearly misses that Teysa's spirit trigger is NONTOKEN-only ('wait is it non token? oh whoops') - self-corrected
Modal spell copied via conspire; table works out the copy can choose its own mode targets... (1:10:50: 'you can do the artifact and enchantment mode and just target Mobilization both times')
key_events.validation: CORRECT (copies of modal spells: mode is copied, targets may change)

key_events.detail: Exiles a nonland permanent; later (1:21:12) Grasp of Fate discussion mirrors the Banishing Light command-zone ruling - table now handles it fluently
Rebound explained: resolves, exiles, recast free at next upkeep ('that's next turn, don't worry about that for now'). Flashback? no - rebound; 1:26:04 recast makes 7 more Kor Soldiers
Sacrifices three white creatures: EXILES Void Winnower - the Winnower lock is broken by an ability (not a cast spell), neatly sidestepping the even-MV restriction
Eldrazi processor timing: a spell cast from HAND that would exile - 'it was exiled, now it's in the graveyard, the processors never got their due' - processors need cards IN exile when they resolve
Destroy-all-creatures wipe (can't be regenerated); Graham responds by sacking three creatures to exile Adam's Artisan of Kozilek; Ian's enchantress rebuilt via Crystal Chimes earlier
Stoneforge Mystic fetch: 'whenever a card says grab a specific type of thing it's always reveal - otherwise there's no way for us to know'. Ben must reveal Batterskull
Annihilator vs destroy-triggers: 'Annihilator is not destroyed, it's SACRIFICE' - sacrifice doesn't trigger destroy-watchers; distinct game terms

Bestows Boon Satyr onto Mirri + Ethereal Armor: 3/2 base -> 7/4 -> +6/+6 from armor (6 enchantments) = 13/10 first strike. Correctly notes two instances of first strike are redundant, NOT double strike (1:52:12, 1:53:01)
Ulamog attack exiles 20 cards from Graham's library ('I tap Ulamog exile 20 cards'); notable exiled cards listed incl. the other Teysa, Spectral Procession

COLOR IDENTITY CATCH: Ben has Westvale Abbey in his Wort (RG) deck - its flip side Ormendahl, Profane Prince is a BLACK creature, so the card's color identity includes black and it is ILLEGAL in an RG deck. Table catches it mid-game ('technically that should not be allowed'), house-rules it: land stays, may never flip. 'It's not cheating, it's just pulling a Serge'
key_events.validation: CORRECT_CATCH - color identity includes both faces

key_events.detail: Fireball mechanics worked through correctly: +1 cost per additional target, damage divided evenly rounded down; conspire copy may choose new targets (2:02:06 'you can change the target of the copy'). 26 total to one player after copy
Oblivion Stone cracked in response - all nonland permanents destroyed; Wort dies -> recast later ('it's a different Wort now') - object identity again
ADAM ELIMINATED - 'took two fireballs to the face, I got murdered'
Graham Path to Exiles Wort in response; copy still resolves ('it still gets conspired, right? yeah' - the copy is already on the stack independent of its source)
key_events.validation: CORRECT - a copy is an independent spell on the stack; removing its source doesn't remove it

key_events.detail: IAN ELIMINATED - 26 damage ('so I'm out'). 2:15:51 related ruling: 'if I die I'm not alive for the spell to resolve' - objects owned by a departed player leave the game

key_events.card: Burn from Within X=23, conspired = 46 at Graham
key_events.detail: Table double-checks: 'you can only conspire once' - one copy max per conspire ('Adam is correct')
Leech-Ridden Swamp activation (each opponent loses 1; needs two black permanents) + Tainted Sigil sac; not enough - GRAHAM ELIMINATED. BEN WINS
'These are fun decks... everybody at one point was in control of the game'
